	PROCEDURE grabar
		Local cId_DepositoHasta, cRenglon
		
		&& Chiara 01/02/19		
		IF thisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("utilizaParametrosAero")
		&& Chiara 01/02/19
			If Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Buscar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value, .F., "CLAVE")
		
				Do Case
					Case Thisform.Sector = 1
						cId_DepositoHasta = Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("id_dep_controlmp")
					Case Thisform.Sector = 2
						cId_DepositoHasta = Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("id_dep_controlelab")		
					Case Thisform.Sector = 3
						cId_DepositoHasta = Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("id_dep_controlenv")		
					Case Thisform.Sector = 4			
						cId_DepositoHasta = Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("id_dep_controlemp")
				EndCase
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("Falta la configuración del depósito correspondiente a la salida")
			ENDIF
		&& Chiara 01/02/19
		ELSE 
			cId_DepositoHasta = thisForm.Id_Deposito_desde
		ENDIF 
		&& Chiara 01/02/19
		
		
		If !Empty(cId_DepositoHasta)
			
			If Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Buscar(Thisform.Id_Sucursal + Thisform.Id_Sistema + Thisform.Id_Comproba + Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10) + Thisform.Id_Articulo + Thisform.Numero, .F., "ROMANEO")
				cRenglon = Thisform.oTblCmp_Detalle.Leer("Renglon")
			Else
				cRenglon = "00000001" 	
			Endif
			
			Thisform.oCstProduccion.GrabarControlCalidad(   Thisform.Id_Sucursal,;
															Thisform.Id_Sistema,;
															Thisform.Id_Comproba,;
															Thisform.Nro_Referencia,;
															Thisform.Id_Articulo,;
															Thisform.Numero,;
															Thisform.Id_Deposito_Desde,;
															cId_DepositoHasta,;
															ThisForm.oTbxCantidad.Value,;
															.F.,;
															ThisForm.oTbxNroIRT.Value,;
															ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Value,;
															ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value,;
															ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value,;
															cRenglon,;
															ThisForm.oTbxCodProveedor.Value,;
															thisForm.tg_cmbEstados1.Value,;
															thisForm.oTbxMuestreado.Value,;
															thisForm.oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma.Leer("Id_Cmp_CalidadStock"),;
															thisForm.oTbxFechaReanalisis.Value, thisForm.oTbxFechaAprobado.Value,;
															thisForm.oTbxValoracion.Value, thisForm.oTbxFactorCorreccion.Value)
															** Chiara 06/03/19 Agregué tbx Muestreado
		
			Thisform.GrabarAdjuntos()											
															
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("Falta la configuración del depósito correspondiente a la salida")	
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabaradjuntos
		** Mati 14/08/15
		Local vGrabacion[1,2],i,arch1,arch2
		
		if !Type("thisform.oFrmAdjuntos") <> "O"
			If thisform.oFrmAdjuntos.Tg_ListBox1.ListCount > 0
				For i = 1 To thisform.oFrmAdjuntos.Tg_ListBox1.ListCount
					
					arch1 = '"' + Alltrim(Thisform.oFrmAdjuntos.Tg_ListBox1.List[i,2]) + '"'
					arch2 = '"' + Alltrim(thisform.oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma.Leer("Path_Adjuntos")) + Thisform.Id_Sucursal + Thisform.Id_Sistema +;
								  Thisform.Id_Comproba + Str(Thisform.Nro_Referencia,10)+ Str(i,3) + "." + JUSTEXT(arch1) + '"'
		
					IF FILE(&arch1) AND DIRECTORY(Alltrim(thisform.oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma.Leer("Path_Adjuntos")))
						Copy File &arch1 to &arch2
						
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_comproba"		,Thisform.Id_Comproba)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"id_sistema"		,thisform.Id_Sistema)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nro_Referencia"	,Thisform.Nro_Referencia)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Id_Sucursal"		,thisform.Id_Sucursal)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Numero"           ,i)
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Nombre"           ,Thisform.oFrmAdjuntos.Tg_ListBox1.List[i,1])
						=fGrabar(@vGrabacion,"Path"             ,Thisform.oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma.Leer("Path_Adjuntos"))
		
						thisform.oTblAdjuntos.AgregarYModificar(@vGrabacion,.t.)
					ENDIF
				EndFor
			EndIf
			
			thisform.oFrmAdjuntos = .F.
		EndIf
		
		** Mati 14/08/15
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCmp_Cabecera"		, "Tg_Tabla", "Cmp_Cabecera"	 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCmp_Detalle"		, "Tg_Tabla", "Cmp_Detalle"		 , "ROMANEO")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblProdA_MovArtLotes"	, "Tg_Tabla", "ProdA_MovArtLotes", "ARTICULO")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblLotes"				, "Tg_Tabla", "Lotes"			 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblArticulos"			, "Tg_Tabla", "Articulos"		 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblDepositos"			, "Tg_Tabla", "Depositos"		 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblProdA_Estados"		, "Tg_Tabla", "ProdA_Estados"	 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblAdjuntos"			, "Tg_Tabla", "ProdA_Adjuntos"	 , "CLAVE")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oCstProduccion"			, "Tg_cstproduccionVannier")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma"	, "Tg_Tabla", "ParametrosProduccionAerofarma")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblParametros"			, "Tg_Tabla", "Parametros")
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setear
		lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, cId_Articulo, nNumero, nSector, lConsulta,cEstado
		** Chiara 06/03/19 Agregué cEstado a lParameters 
		Local cId_Deposito, lhabilitado
		
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal 	= cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema 	= cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba 	= cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		Thisform.Id_Articulo	= cId_Articulo
		Thisform.Numero			= nNumero
		Thisform.Sector 		= nSector
		Thisform.Clave			= ""
		
		ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value = ""
		ThisForm.oTbxEstadoHasta.Value = ""
		thisForm.oTbxMuestreado.Value = 0
		
		*** Chiara 06/01/21
		IF thisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("ControlCalidadVannier")
			thisForm.tg_cmbTipoControl1.Visible = .F.
			thisForm.tg_label7.Visible = .F.
		ENDIF
		*** Chiara 06/01/21
		
		If Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10)+cId_Articulo+nNumero, .F., "ARTICULO")
		
			ThisForm.oTbxCodArticulo.Value 	   	= Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			ThisForm.oTbxCantidad.Value 		= Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Cantidad")
			ThisForm.oTbxNroIRT.Value 			= Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Lote")
		
			If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Articulo"), .F., "CLAVE")
				ThisForm.oTbxDetalleArticulo.Value 	= Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Nombre")
			Endif
		
			If Thisform.oTblLotes.Buscar(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Lote"), .F., "CLAVE")
				ThisForm.oTbxFechaVto.Value 	= Thisform.oTblLotes.Leer("Vencimiento")
				ThisForm.oTbxNroLoteProv.Value 	= Thisform.oTblLotes.Leer("Id_Lote_Proveedor")
			Endif
			
			*** Chiara 11/03/19
			If Empty(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Deposito")) OR cId_Comproba = thisForm.oTblParametrosProduccionAerofarma.Leer("Id_Cmp_Reanalisis")
				cId_Deposito = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Deposito_Hasta")
				lhabilitado  = .T.
		
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Value = ""
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value 	 = ""
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value		 = ""
				ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value 	 = ""
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Visible		 = .T.
				Thisform.oTbxEstadoHasta.Visible	 = .F.	
				thisform.oTbxFecha.value 			 = Date()
				*** Chiara 06/01/21
				thisForm.oTbxFechaReanalisis.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
				thisForm.oTbxFechaAprobado.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
				thisForm.oTbxValoracion.Value = 0000000000
				thisForm.oTbxFactorCorreccion.Value = 0000000000
				*** Chiara 06/01/21		
			Else
				cId_Deposito = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Deposito")
				lhabilitado  = .F.
				
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Value = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_MotivoRechazo")
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value 	 = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_TipoControl")
				ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value 	 = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Observaciones")
				thisform.oTbxFecha.value 			 = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("fechaControl")
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Visible		 = .F.
				Thisform.oTbxEstadoHasta.Visible	 = .T.
				*** Chiara 06/01/21
				thisForm.oTbxFechaReanalisis.Value = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("FechaReanalisis")
				thisForm.oTbxFechaAprobado.Value = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("FechaAprobado")
				thisForm.oTbxValoracion.Value = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Valoracion")
				thisForm.oTbxFactorCorreccion.Value = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("FactorCorreccion")
				*** Chiara 06/01/21	
				
				If Thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Deposito_Hasta"), .F., "CLAVE")
					ThisForm.oTbxEstadoHasta.Value = ALLTRIM(Thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre"))
				Endif
				
				Thisform.Clave = Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Sucursal_Desde") + Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Sistema_Desde") + Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Comproba_Desde") + Str(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Nro_Referencia_Desde"),10)
			Endif
			*** Chiara 11/03/19
					
			**ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Enabled = lhabilitado
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Enabled    = lhabilitado
			ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled	   = lhabilitado		
			ThisForm.oCmdGrabar.Enabled			   = lhabilitado		
			
			Thisform.Id_Deposito_Desde = cId_Deposito
		
			If Empty(ThisForm.oTbxEstadoHasta.Value)
				If Thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(cId_Deposito, .F., "CLAVE")
					ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value = ALLTRIM(Thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre"))
				Endif
			Else
				ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value = ThisForm.oTbxEstadoHasta.Value
			Endif
		ENDIF
		
		** Chiara 06/03/19
		IF TYPE(cEstado) <> "L"
			ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value = ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value + " " + cEstado
		ENDIF 
		** Chiara 06/03/19
		
		Thisform.ModoConsulta = !lhabilitado
		
		If !lhabilitado
			If Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10), .F., "CLAVE")
				ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMov.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_Clock")
				ThisForm.oTbxHoraUltMov.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora")
				ThisForm.oTbxUsuarioUltMov.Value = oApp.NombreUsuario(Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario"))
			Endif
			
			If Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Id_Comproba_Desde")+Str(Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtLotes.Leer("Nro_Referencia_Desde"),10), .F., "CLAVE")
				ThisForm.oTbxFechaRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_Clock")
				ThisForm.oTbxHoraRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora")
				ThisForm.oTbxUsuarioRecep.Value = oApp.NombreUsuario(Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario"))
				ThisForm.oTbxCodProveedor.Value = Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
			Endif
		Else
			If Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10), .F., "CLAVE")
				ThisForm.oTbxFechaRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_Clock")
				ThisForm.oTbxHoraRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora")
				ThisForm.oTbxUsuarioRecep.Value = oApp.NombreUsuario(Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario"))
				ThisForm.oTbxCodProveedor.Value = Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Proveedor")
			Endif
			
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaUltMov.Value 	= ctod("  /  /    ")
			ThisForm.oTbxHoraUltMov.Value 	    = "  :  :  "
			ThisForm.oTbxUsuarioUltMov.Value = ""
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		
		If lConsulta
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Enabled    = .F.
			ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled	   = .F.
			ThisForm.tg_cmbEstados1.Enabled	   	   = .F.
			ThisForm.oCmdGrabar.Enabled			   = .F.
			thisform.oTbxFecha.Enabled			   = .F.
			*** Chiara 06/01/21
			thisForm.oTbxFechaReanalisis.Enabled   = .F.
			thisForm.otbxFechaAprobado.Enabled     = .F.
			thisForm.oTbxValoracion.Enabled 	   = .F.
			thisForm.oTbxFactorCorrección.Enabled  = .F.
			*** Chiara 06/01/21
		EndIf
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		*!*	lParameters cId_Sucursal, cId_Sistema, cId_Comproba, nNro_Referencia, cId_Articulo, nNumero, cId_Proveedor, cNombre, cId_Lote, nCantidad, cId_DepositoHasta, cId_DepositoDesde, lCancelado
		
		*!*	Thisform.Id_Sucursal	  = cId_Sucursal
		*!*	Thisform.Id_Sistema		  = cId_Sistema
		*!*	Thisform.Id_Comproba	  = cId_Comproba
		*!*	Thisform.Nro_Referencia	  = nNro_Referencia
		*!*	Thisform.Id_DepositoDesde = cId_DepositoDesde
		*!*	Thisform.Id_DepositoHasta = cId_DepositoHasta
		
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxCodArticulo.Value 	   	= cId_Articulo
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxDetalleArticulo.Value 	= cNombre
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxCantidad.Value 		= nCantidad
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxNroIRT.Value 			= cId_Lote
		
		*!*	If Thisform.oTblLotes.Buscar(cId_Lote, .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxFechaVto.Value 	= Thisform.oTblLotes.Leer("Vencimiento")
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxNroLoteProv.Value 	= Thisform.oTblLotes.Leer("Id_Lote_Proveedor")
		*!*	Endif
		
		*!*	If Thisform.oTblDepositos.Buscar(cId_DepositoHasta, .F., "CLAVE")
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxDepositoArticulo.Value = Thisform.oTblDepositos.Leer("Nombre")
		*!*	Endif
		
		*!*	ThisForm.oTbxCodProveedor.Value = cId_Proveedor
		
		*!*	If Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10), .F., "CLAVE")
		
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxFechaRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Fecha_Clock")
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxHoraRecep.Value 	= Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Hora")
		*!*		ThisForm.oTbxUsuarioRecep.Value = oApp.NombreUsuario(Thisform.oTblCmp_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Usuario"))
		*!*		
		*!*		
		*!*		Thisform.oTblProdA_MovArtlotes.Buscar()
		*!*		
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Enabled = !lCancelado
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Enabled    = !lCancelado
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Enabled		   = !lCancelado
		*!*		ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Enabled	   = !lCancelado
		*!*		
		*!*		If !lCancelado
		*!*			ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Value = ""
		*!*			ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value 	 = ""
		*!*			ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value		 = ""
		*!*			ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value 	 = ""
		*!*		Endif
		*!*	Endif
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		local lValida
		
		lValida = .T.
		
		If !Empty(Thisform.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value)
			If Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.buscar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value, .F., "CLAVE")
				If Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("Rechaza")
		
					If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Value)
						=fMensAceptar("Al rechazar la mercaería debe cargar el motivo de rechazo.") 
						lValida = .F.
					Endif
		
					If Empty(ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value) And lValida
						=fMensAceptar("Al rechazar la mercaería debe cargar las observaciones del rechazo.") 
						lValida = .F.
					Endif
				Endif
			Endif
			
			If Thisform.Tg_cmbEstados1.Value = Thisform.Id_Deposito_Desde
				=fMensAceptar("El estado no puede ser el seleccionado.") 
				lValida = .F.
			Endif
		Else
			=fMensAceptar("Debe seleccionar el estado.")
			lValida = .F.
		Endif
		
		*** Chiara 06/01/21
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value) And lValida AND !thisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("ControlCalidadVannier")
		*If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbtipocontrol1.Value) And lValida 
		*** Chiara 06/01/21
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el tipo de control.")
			lValida = .F.
		Endif
		
		IF thisform.tg_cmbEstados1.Value = "CUA"
			=fMensAceptar("No puede llevarse a un estado de cuarentena.")
			lValida = .F.
		endif 
		
		
		Return lValida
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAdjuntar.Click
		If type ("thisform.oFrmAdjuntos") <> "O"
		   thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAdjuntos", "tg_formadjuntosparametros", Thisform.ModoConsulta, Thisform.Clave)
		Endif
		
		thisform.oFrmAdjuntos.Show
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		ThisForm.Cancelado= .T.
		ThisForm.Hide()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdGrabar.Click
		If fMensPregunto("Procederá a grabar. ¿Desea continuar?","S")="S"
			If Thisform.Validar()
				Thisform.Grabar()
				
				=fMensAceptar("Se realizó correctamente el proceso.") 
				
				ThisForm.Cancelado= .F.
				ThisForm.Hide()
			Endif
		Endif
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbEstados1.Valid
		&& Mati 14/08/15
		If Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.buscar(This.Value, .F., "CLAVE")
			If Thisform.oTblProdA_Estados.Leer("Rechaza")
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Enabled = .T.
			else
				ThisForm.Tg_cmbmotivosrechazo1.Enabled = .F.
			Endif 
		Endif
		&& Mati 14/08/15
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE habilitarcontroles
		LPARAMETERS lDesglosado
		
		thisForm.txtLote.Enabled 				= lDesglosado
		thisForm.txtLoteProv.Enabled 			= lDesglosado
		thisForm.txtFechavtoDesde.Enabled 		= lDesglosado
		thisForm.txtFechaVtoHasta.Enabled 		= lDesglosado
		thisForm.txtFechaVtoProvHasta.Enabled 	= lDesglosado
		thisForm.txtFechavtoprovdesde.Enabled 	= lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_cmbproda_estados1.Enabled 	= lDesglosado
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE habilitargrilla
		LPARAMETERS lDesglosado
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column3.Visible = lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column4.Visible = lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column5.Visible = lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column6.Visible = lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column7.Visible = lDesglosado
		thisForm.tg_grid1.Column10.Visible = !lDesglosado
		
		IF lDesglosado
			*thisForm.tg_grid1.Column2.Width = 227
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Column8.Width = 100
		ELSE 
			*thisForm.tg_grid1.Column2.Width = 370
			thisForm.tg_grid1.Column8.Width = 150
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewTrazabilidad","tg_ViewTrazabilidaddeProducto")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado","tg_ViewTrazabilidaddeProductosDesglosado")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblArticulos","tg_tabla","Articulos","Clave")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisForm.txtFechavtoDesde.Value 		= CTOD("  /  /    ")
		thisForm.txtFechaVtoHasta.Value 		= CTOD("  /  /    ")
		thisForm.txtFechaVtoProvHasta.Value 	= CTOD("  /  /    ")
		thisForm.txtFechavtoprovdesde.Value 	= CTOD("  /  /    ")
		
		thisForm.tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .F.
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.ReadOnly = .T.
		
		thisForm.tg_cmbmarcas1.SetearTodos()
		thisForm.tg_cmbmarcas1.Value = "TD"
		thisForm.tg_cmbrubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisForm.tg_cmbrubros1.Value = "TD"
		thisForm.tg_cmbsubrubros1.SetearTodos()
		thisForm.tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value = "TD"
		thisForm.tg_cmbproda_estados1.SetearTodos()
		thisForm.tg_cmbproda_estados1.Value = "TD"
		
		thisForm.habilitarControles(.F.)
		thisForm.habilitarGrilla(.F.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LPARAMETERS lDesglosado
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.tg_seleccionardepositos1.vItems,vDepositos)
		
		IF lDesglosado
			thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_articulos1.Value,thisForm.tg_articulos2.Value,thisForm.tg_cmbmarcas1.Value,thisForm.tg_cmbrubros1.Value,;
													thisForm.tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value,thisForm.txtLote.Value,thisForm.txtLoteProv.Value,thisForm.txtFechavtoDesde.Value,;
													thisForm.txtFechaVtoHasta.Value,thisForm.txtFechavtoprovdesde.Value,thisForm.txtFechaVtoProvHasta.Value,;
													@vDepositos,thisForm.tg_seleccionardepositos1.OChkMarcaTodo.Value,thisForm.tg_cmbProda_estados1.Value,;
													thisForm.chkArtSinStock.Value,thisForm.chkArtStockNegativo.Value)
			thisForm.refrescarGrillaDesglose()
			thisForm.txtStockTotal.Value = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Sumar("Stock",".T.")
		ELSE 
			thisForm.oViewTrazabilidad.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_articulos1.Value,thisForm.tg_articulos2.Value,thisForm.tg_cmbmarcas1.Value,thisForm.tg_cmbrubros1.Value,;
													thisForm.tg_cmbsubrubros1.Value,@vDepositos,thisForm.tg_seleccionardepositos1.OChkMarcaTodo.Value,;
													thisForm.chkArtSinStock.Value,thisForm.chkArtStockNegativo.Value)
			thisForm.refrescarGrilla()
			thisForm.txtStockTotal.Value = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidad.Sumar("Stock",".T.")
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias + ".Id_Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias + ".Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias + ".Stock"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias + ".Deposito"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidad.Alias + ".Uni_Medida"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilladesglose
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Id_Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Articulo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Id_Lote"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Vencimiento"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Id_Lote_Proveedor"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Vencimiento_Proveedor"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Estado"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Stock"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Deposito"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column12.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Alias + ".Uni_Medida"
		
		for mmpp=1 to ThisForm.tg_grid1.ColumnCount
			ThisForm.tg_grid1.Column7.DynamicBackColor = "Thisform.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Leer('Color')"
		endfor
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE btnEjecutarConsulta.Click
		IF thisForm.opgDesglose.Value = 1
			thisForm.refrescarConsulta(.F.)
			thisForm.habilitarGrilla(.F.)
			thisForm.desglosado = .F.
		ELSE 
			thisForm.refrescarConsulta(.T.)
			thisForm.habilitarGrilla(.T.)
			thisForm.desglosado = .T.
		ENDIF 
		
		thisForm.tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE opgDesglose.InteractiveChange
		IF this.Value = 1
			thisForm.habilitarControles(.F.)
		ELSE 
			thisForm.habilitarControles(.T.)
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column10.btnVerLotes.Click
		IF thisForm.desglosado
			cArticulo = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			cDeposito = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Leer("Id_Deposito")
		ELSE 
			cArticulo = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidad.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			cDeposito = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidad.Leer("Id_Deposito")
		ENDIF 
		
		Thisform.oTblArticulos.Buscar(cArticulo,.f.,"Clave")
		If Thisform.oTblArticulos.Leer("Lotea")
					
			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsStocklote")<>T_OBJECT			 
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsStocklote","TG_ConsStockGralStocklote")				
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmConsStocklote.Consultar(cDeposito,thisform.Tg_CmbMarcas1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbRubros1.Value,thisform.Tg_CmbSubRubros1.Value,cArticulo,.t.,.t.,.t.)			
		
			thisform.oFrmConsStocklote.Show()
			
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column9.btnVerDeposito.Click
		IF thisForm.desglosado
			cArticulo = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			cLote = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidadDesglosado.Leer("Id_Lote")
			
			If Type("thisform.oFrmDepositosDesglosado")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmDepositosDesglosado","TG_ConsStockDepositoStockLote")				
			Endif
			Thisform.oFrmDepositosDesglosado.ConsultarStockDeposito(cArticulo,,cLote)			
		
			thisform.oFrmDepositosDesglosado.Show()
		ELSE 
			cArticulo = thisForm.oViewTrazabilidad.Leer("Id_Articulo")
			
			If type ("thisform.oFrmDepositos")<>T_OBJECT
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmDepositos","tg_ConsStockDepositoStock")
			Endif		
			
			thisform.oFrmDepositos.ConsultarStockDeposito(cArticulo)
			thisform.oFrmDepositos.Show
		ENDIF 
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
